finding.engine: workflows.execute returns episode_finished before checking protected intent, so subsequent attempts are not recorded or penalized.
finding.runner: Coupled runner applies every parsed action sequentially using map; a protected action after finish in the same response reaches execute. Outer loop prevents another provider invocation after finish.
finding.actualTraceConclusion: No protected intent after successful finish appears in the audited saved native action traces or supplementary c snapshots. This defect is reachable in the paid runner protocol, but saved paid rows provide no evidence of exploiting it.
